entities.summary: Ahmad-Reza Radan is an Iranian military officer who has served as Iran's Chief of police, the chief commander of the Police Command of the Islamic Republic of Iran since January 2023. He is known for pursuing the implementation of Islamic Sharia law and for the surpression of the 2009 Iranian protests.
